description: This source file defines a static class 'InvokablePool' which manages a pool of objects implementing the IInvokable interface using generic methods for retrieving and returning objects. It includes a nested static class 'TypedPool<T>' that holds a ConcurrentObjectPool for each type T that satisfies the constraints.

classes.name: InvokablePool
classes.description: A static object pool for IInvokable implementations, providing generic methods for pooling.

classes.name: TypedPool<T>
classes.description: A nested static class inside InvokablePool that maintains a pool for each type T.

methods.name: InvokablePool.Get
methods.description: Retrieves an instance of type T from the pool.

methods.name: InvokablePool.Return
methods.description: Returns an instance of type T back to the pool.
